resolved_items.item: direct judge left dependency_coverage item D002 unclear
resolved_items.resolution: D002 has a determinate meaning: one function F(x,z) must represent a(x)u'(x) by the actual derivative of F(x,u(x)) for every profile differentiable at the tested point, with the state unchanged. Constant profiles force every fixed-state slice F(·,z) to be constant on R. Writing F(x,z)=g(z), affine profiles then force g'(z)=a(x) for every x and z, so a must be constant. Conversely, constant a=c admits F(x,z)=cz. Thus flux existence in D002 is equivalent to coefficient constancy. This establishes a substantive fixed-state flux obstruction, not an obstruction to every transformed conservation law.
